title: Office Role Reversal: Microsoft Puts Word and Excel Inside Copilot AI as the Centerpiece

content_html:
At yesterday's Ignite 2026 conference, Microsoft officially announced that Office is opening a "new chapter." Office software is no longer just a document, spreadsheet, and presentation tool; it is transforming into an "intelligent office system" where AI agents work together. Until now, Copilot was an assistant embedded in each app, but now the whole model has been reversed. The new Copilot app is at the center, integrating a complete Word, Excel, and PowerPoint collaboration experience.

In short, documents are born naturally Users simply describe their requirements in natural language, and Copilot can generate documents in Word, PowerPoint, and Excel and open them beside the chat window. They can edit manually or keep giving instructions to the AI. All content is saved in OneDrive and protected by enterprise security and compliance frameworks.

Powerful dedicated tools for sales and the workplace The public release of Copilot for Sales Frontier for sales connects to CRM through plug-ins and integrates with business tools such as Zendesk, HubSpot, Notion, DocuSign, and ZoomInfo to help salespeople organize customer information, manage follow-up processes, and generate materials. For general workplace users, there is "Today" in private preview. It automatically aggregates email, calendar, chat, and meetings to create a summary of the day, and can also draft emails and coordinate meetings. Copilot in OneNote organizes messy notes, Pages turns prompts and materials into interactive pages, and Workspaces provides templated shared spaces; in the future, AI agents will also be able to join groups and collaborate.
